title: Little Nachman Part 13
body:
Translation by Rabbi Lazer Brody
and illustrations by Rebecca Shapiro
 
 
Little Nachman – Part 13
 
Nachman Comes to Help
 
Nachman and Shimon planned to meet every day, to talk and to strengthen their faith and prayers. One day, Nachman waited for Shimon, but Shimon didn’t come at the time that they had planned. Nachman waited a little longer and said to himself: "My friend Shimon is never late; maybe I should go to his house to see if everything is alright."
 
Nachman asked his mother’s permission to go to Shimon’s house. She agreed, so he went immediately to see his good friend. He knocked on the door; Shimon greeted him with a smile.
 
"My friend Shimon is never late; maybe I should go to his house to see if everything is alright."

To be continued, G-d willing.
